description_en: Modifies the resource group of an instance
description_zh: 修改实例所在的资源组
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

vault: backup vault
client: backup client
hanainstance: SAP HANA instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

vault：备份库。
client：备份客户端。
hanainstance：SAP HANA实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. For example, if ResourceType is set to vault, ResourceId specifies the ID of the backup vault
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型的ID标识符。例如，当ResourceType=vault时，则ResourceId可以理解为备份库ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group. You can view available resource groups in the Resource Group console
parameters.help_zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request is successful, successful is returned. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: successful
false: failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
